name: Blaise Pascal
contribution: A French mathematician, physicist, inventor, philosopher, and Catholic writer.
legacy: He later corresponded with Pierre de Fermat on probability theory, strongly influencing the development of modern economics and social science.

checks.lead: Blaise Pascal (19 June 1623 – 19 August 1662) was a French mathematician, physicist, inventor, philosopher, and Catholic writer.
